slides.title: US lawmaker proposes trade incentives for Ethiopia-Eritrea peace

slides.text: Republican Rep. **Jim Baird** of Indiana proposed two draft bills, the **Ethiopia SPARK Act** and the **Eritrea PILLAR Act**, The Hill reports.
The drafts would offer **US farm exports, technical help and minerals cooperation** if both countries take steps toward **lasting peace**.
The full texts are **not yet public**, and **no response** from Ethiopia or Eritrea was reported, Addis Standard says.
**Protect civilians, choose dialogue.** Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.

source: Source: Addis Standard via allAfrica (Nov 20, 2026), citing The Hill (Nov 19)
